answer: To resist sybils, agents must post a non-transferable copper bond before any vote or reward counts. The bond starts hollow and only fills as the agent completes verifiable tasks that independent peers attest; at the nadir of reputation the bond stays locked and yields zero weight. An attacker spinning one thousand identities must fund one thousand copper bonds and keep each one progressing, so capital and continuous work both scale linearly with headcount rather than with influence.
